title: Thu 05 Nov 2026: Dow's best day in over a year, oil slumps, Bank of England decides today, ESG ratings rules final
summary: A clear Democratic win in the US midterms sends the Dow up about three percent, oil down almost nine percent and gold above four thousand dollars, while London closes up nearly two percent. We preview today's Bank of England decision, where a rise to four percent is widely expected, then cover the FCA's final ESG ratings rules, tomorrow's transaction reporting deadline and the fund liquidity timetable. In funds: continuation funds, private-asset ETFs and LTAFs in ISAs. Three COO action points and the diary for the week.
